draft.title: Missing derivatives of a thin singular value decomposition
draft.body:
## Reproducer

Run this example

```sh
cat > thin-svd.mlir <<'MLIR'
func.func @vals(%a: tensor<4x3xf32>) -> tensor<3xf32> {
  %r:4 = enzymexla.linalg.svd %a : (tensor<4x3xf32>) -> (tensor<4x3xf32>, tensor<3xf32>, tensor<3x3xf32>, tensor<i32>)
  return %r#1 : tensor<3xf32>
}
MLIR
enzymexlamlir-opt thin-svd.mlir --enzyme-wrap='infn=vals outfn= retTys=enzyme_active argTys=enzyme_active mode=ReverseModeCombined'
```

## Observed

The upstream base used by the stack has no adjoint for the SVD operation.

## Expected

For distinct, nonzero singular values and output cotangent g, the real input adjoint should be U diag(g) Vᵀ.

## Proposed fix

Define forward and reverse rules for the thin SVD, reusing the primal factors and handling rectangular shapes. Phase-dependent complex objectives need separate treatment. The upstream reverse proposal is [#2551](https://github.com/EnzymeAD/Enzyme-JAX/pull/2551); the fork rules were described in [#3277](https://github.com/EnzymeAD/Enzyme-JAX/pull/3277).
